bullets: Chat in Simple is one clean column, like Expert: your message, then the answer in a card, with the chat box at the bottom. Under each answer: Copy, Try again, Make changes and Save as file. Everything else sits behind Make changes.
The History drawer works: clicks inside it no longer close it, a chat opens when you click it or press Enter, and search keeps every letter you type.
A spreadsheet the AI lays out as cells, or gives as CSV text, is saved as a real spreadsheet with its formulas.
When an AI answers a spreadsheet, Word or slides request with code instead of the content, Meldmind asks it once more for the real thing.
A file that gets cut off is finished as code only, and a JSON file that still does not read is asked for again in a smaller form.
Practice answers fit what you asked: scripts stay scripts in every language, PowerShell is real PowerShell, JSON has the number of records you asked for, and a guest list has people in it.
The Just chat bar is readable in dark, and the first screen says key far less, with no rows you cannot act on.
The What's new note keeps its Got it button in view, and the window waits for the dock to slide away before it grows.

A file that gets cut off is finished as code only, and a JSON file that still does not read is asked for again in a smaller form.
